title: Material for MkDocs palette colours
description: The colours accepted by theme.palette.primary and theme.palette.accent.

id.description: The identifier as it appears in the configuration file, for example deep-purple.

hex.description: A representative shade of the colour, used for the swatch shown next to the name.

descriptionKey.description: The bundle key of the one line description shown in QuickDoc and behind the offered value.

primary.description: Whether the colour is accepted for theme.palette.primary.

accent.description: Whether the colour is accepted for theme.palette.accent.

custom.description: Whether this entry is the `custom` placeholder rather than a colour of the palette.
